supplements.finding_text: L924-L929: DETTMP is first assigned the reciprocal determinant and then compared with 0.0. A singular denominator raises division-by-zero/Inf rather than making its reciprocal exactly zero, so the STOPP singular-transform guard is ineffective.
supplements.authoritative_quote:
DETTMP = 1./( CUE(L)*CVN(L) - CUN(L)*CVE(L) )
      if( DETTMP == 0.0 )then
        write(6,6262)
        write(6,6263) IL(L), JL(L)
        call STOPP('.', 1)
supplements.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)
supplements.rationale: DETTMP=1/det then compared ==0.0: reciprocal of singular det is Inf not 0, so STOPP guard is dead code

supplements.finding_text: AGE is declared INTENT(OUT) at L110, but its incoming values are read in the initiation/aging test at L141-L146 and as neighbor history at L175-L214, before every element is necessarily defined by this invocation. The algorithm requires persistent prior age, so the declared interface conflicts with its use and should be assessed as INOUT.
supplements.rationale: span-verified 2026-08-27: AGE declared DIMENSION(M,N),INTENT(OUT) (L112) but read as prior/persistent history at L152,L155 and neighbor L183=AGE1=AGE(I-1,J) before any write in this invocation. INTENT(OUT) makes actual arg undefined on entry; breaker age-tracking requires persistence → should be INOUT. base missed. (manifestation compiler-dependent: many compilers leave INTENT(OUT) arrays intact, but it is UB.)

supplements.finding_text: Use-before-assignment across branches: breaking_kernel assigns DXg and DYg only inside the Age_sh<=ZERO, non-immediate-trigger branch at L168-L184, but all paths then use them to compute xmk/ymk at L234-L238. If the immediate trigger branch L162-L164 or positive-age branch L166-L167 is taken, wavemaker footprint selection consumes undefined DXg/DYg.
supplements.authoritative_quote:
REAL(SP) :: xmk,ymk,DXg,DYg
…
                DXg=DX_d
                DYg=DY_d
…
        xmk=(I-Ibeg)*DXg + (iista-1)*DXg
        ymk=(J-Jbeg)*DYg + (jjsta-1)*DYg
# else
        xmk=(I-Ibeg)*DXg
supplements.rationale: span-verified 2026-08-27: breaking_kernel DXg/DYg(decl L137) assigned only in innermost Age_sh<=ZERO branch (L173-174/179-180); breaking(AGE=DT) and aging(Age_sh>ZERO) branches leave unset, yet xmk/ymk use them after all ENDIFs at L234-237. supplements.finding_text: Out-of-bounds search: lines 251-254 increment Kstart while TIME(Kstart)<time_cut without checking Kstart<=Ndata (or Ntotal). If time_cut exceeds the final available timestamp, TIME is indexed beyond valid data and potentially beyond its allocation before the loop can terminate.
supplements.rationale: span-verified 2026-08-27: unbounded DO WHILE search over TIME() with no Kstart<=Ndata/Ntotal bound; time_cut past last timestamp reads uninitialized elements and past Ntotal=10000 exceeds allocation (OOB). base missed.
